title: termal_resume_after_test_runs refuses a run registered on a remote host with 404 "not indexed" instead of a typed cross-host answer
outcome: A native wait naming a run that is registered on another host either settles through that host's existing completion route, or is refused with a typed answer that says the run is remote and names the supported completion route (the runner's mailbox), instead of a bare 404 'not indexed' that reads like a lost run.
acceptance: termal_resume_after_test_runs given a run id registered on a remote host (and not on this host) returns a typed remote-run answer naming the host and the supported completion route, distinct from the unknown-id 404 and from the same-host index-lag case of w-b7c81c59f96e; or, if a cross-host wait is implemented, it settles once from the remote terminal without polling or duplicate runs.
Deterministic tests cover a remote-registered id, an unknown id and a same-host indexed id; no test verification credit is invented for a remote run.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
